reasons.plausibility: Shifting to binder jetting and sintering to reduce thermal gradients and thus residual stress is scientifically sound for high-entropy alloys, though some uncertainty remains regarding full densification and microstructural control at lower temperatures.
reasons.testability: A direct, side-by-side comparison measuring residual stress and mechanical properties for both processes provides a clear and decisive method to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This alternative approach targets a critical manufacturing challenge and outlines a practical methodology, making it highly relevant and beneficial to researchers looking to mitigate thermal stresses in miniature AM parts.
